calibration_failure_definition: use frozen MOV0 Newton procedure; null if no convergence within100 iterations, singular Hessian, nonfinite iterate or max absolute coefficient>30 (separation/numerical instability flag); diagnostic numerical rule is not model selection or success threshold
mandatory_runtime_tests: all scoring fight IDs exactly match frozen scoring digests; unique rows; no scoring exclusion based on outcome
changing/removing all validation outcomes leaves scoring eligibility and predictions unchanged
decisions absent from every fit, imputer, encoder, scaler and C selection input
inner/outer preprocessing statistics derived solely from their finish-training ID sets
swapping every side/directional input gives identical probabilities atol1e-12 rtol0 on all scored rows, with explicit asymmetric-null fixtures
never fit a separate side median; test shared pooled imputation under side swap
complete-case and null-side tests; known unseen division produces documented all-zero one-hot without fitting validation categories
assert every binary probability finite/in[0,1], SUB complement; composition all3 bounded/sum1 atol1e-12 rtol0
verify frozen MOV0 MIN OOF bytes then exact one-to-one fight/year join; never refit
verify no target/terrain/archetype/audit-rate/odds columns can enter allowlist
logloss composition identity before log clipping; report clipping exception count
missing_metrics: null plus reason for one-class, constant predictor, failed calibration convergence, separation, N0; no silent zero or NaN JSON
no_posthoc_adaptation: run failures stop with evidence; scientific or solver changes require a new preregistration/version before rerun

conditional_oof_all_eligible.csv.label_policy: first write scored rows without outcomes; then one-to-one label join for evaluation

required_run_artifacts: RUN_MANIFEST.json with versions, input SHA256, feature/transform order, contract-manifest hash and artifact hashes
TRAINING_AUDIT.json with every inner/outer ID digest, pooled median/mode/category/scaler statistics, class counts and C-selection grid scores
MODELS with fitted preprocessing and coefficients per outer surface; C0 scalar stored separately
archetype_composition.csv with all15 statuses and both denominators
INTERPRETATION.md with all predeclared comparisons and qualitative classifications
IMPLICATIONS_FOR_HYBRID_SIMULATOR.md with evidence and limitations, no transitions
serialization: UTF-8, JSON sorted keys indent2 final LF; CSV final LF floats17 significant digits; ID/event/year sort specified by fold plan then surface/system frozen order
